final_message:
Configured DNS for the requested machine names and four mail domains. All 60 PCs now use the lab’s recursive resolver; existing addresses, routes and connections were preserved.

The artificial root runs on **pc1**, the resolver on **pc2**, and authoritative zones on pc3 (`com`), pc4 (`net`), pc5 (`org`), pc6 (`io`), pc8 (`it`), pc9 (`gov`), pc10 (`edu`) and pc12 (`info`). The mail records identify the requested machines; they do not configure mail services.

All startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. BIND’s configuration-checking tools were unavailable locally, and the lab was not started, so DNS resolution and cross-network reachability still need runtime verification.
